# Auth0: create a provisioning configuration

Runtime: GLM / AgentPress material kit.

To create an Auth0 provisioning configuration, you must SOURCE FACT REQUIRED the exact endpoint path, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED the required request body schema, SOURCE FACT REQUIRED the authentication requirements and scopes, and SOURCE FACT REQUIRED the response shape and status codes. Without these, agents will misconfigure provisioning and break auth flows silently.

Search intents:
- Auth0 provisioning configuration create
- Auth0 API provisioning setup
- Auth0 OIDC provisioning management

Validation command: python3 scripts/agentpress.py material-kit-validate agentpress/material-kits/auth0-provisioning-config --json
